title: security: rbac-v2 enforce KMS region residency + audit logging hardening
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Enforce KMS region residency constraints for RBAC v2 policies; upgrade audit log schema to include KMS key residency metadata; provide migration and rollout plan; no user-visible API changes unless KMS residency policies are violated.
description: Summary: Add enforcement for KMS region residency constraints as part of RBAC v2 policy evaluation and harden audit logging to include KMS key residency metadata. Motivation: Customers in regulated industries require strong guarantees that encryption keys and plaintext never cross geographic boundaries. Previously we emitted audit entries without consistent KMS residency fields and RBAC v2 only audited policy violations in an advisory mode. This PR makes residency checks enforceable for users with the 'require_kms_residency' policy flag and expands audit logs to capture key ARN, kms_region, and residency_verification_result.
commits: Add RBAC v2 residency enforcement hook and policy schema (aisha/eng-4812)
Audit logging: add kms_region, key_arn, residency_result, retention tags (aisha/logs-2026)
Unit and integration tests for residency enforcement and migration script (aisha/tests-2026)
Rollout docs and Linear link updates (aisha/docs-2026)
review_thread: Marco Ruiz (2026-02-21): Can you clarify how the residency check interacts with existing cross-region fallback? If a model route falls back to a different region should we block or only log?

Aisha Patel (2026-02-21): The policy flag 'require_kms_residency' is opt-in. When enabled we block operations that would route encrypted content to a different region; fallback that would move key usage across regions will be denied. For non-enforced advisory mode we only log. Added a note in docs and a unit test for fallback denial.

Lena Thompson (2026-02-22): Audit entries look good but we need to ensure PII is not duplicated in new fields; please redact key material and include only key_arn and region. Also request to add retention TTL field.
Aisha Patel (2026-02-22): Updated audit schema to include only key_arn (no key material) and kms_region; added residency_verification_result and retention_ttl_seconds. Updated tests accordingly.
Oliver Chen (2026-02-23): Security scan flagged dynamic YAML loading in policy_schema as a potential injection vector. Recommend using strict unmarshalling and validation.
Aisha Patel (2026-02-23): Replaced generic yaml.Unmarshal with schema-validated parsing and added unit tests for malformed policy blobs. CI re-run green.
Marco Ruiz (2026-02-24): Approve after the storage migration runbook is added to the PR. Please ensure the migration is backward compatible and we can roll back if audit schema write fails.

Aisha Patel (2026-02-24): Added migration runbook and rollback plan in docs/security/kms-residency.md. Migration writes to a new schema version and preserves old audit table until a manual cleanup step.
Lena Thompson (2026-02-25): Quick question on metrics: can we emit a counter for residency_denied vs residency_logged? That would help SRE monitoring.
Aisha Patel (2026-02-25): Added metrics: audit.residency.denied and audit.residency.logged. Updated observability-pack to include dashboards.
Oliver Chen (2026-02-26): CI flaky e2e failure observed in integration cluster when KMS emulator returns transient errors; suggest retry with exponential backoff in residency_checker.
Aisha Patel (2026-02-26): Added robust retry with jitter and added integration test that simulates transient KMS failures. CI now passing.
Marco Ruiz (2026-02-27): LGTM, merging with squash.
ci_checks: integration-tests: passed (flaky fixed after retry addition)
security-scan: initial failure (yaml unmarshal), fixed and re-run passed
notes_on_rollout: Gradual rollout: start in advisory mode for all orgs, enable enforcement for pilot tenants (compliance customers) after migration. Provide a 2-week observation window and monitor audit.residency.denied metric. Migration creates new audit schema version; rollback plan preserves old table and backfills missing fields if needed.
testing_performed: Unit tests covering policy parsing and enforcement; integration tests with KMS emulator including transient error scenarios; migration dry-run on staging; manual verification of audit entries for pilot tenant; observability dashboard added and metrics validated.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: enforcement could block customer traffic if misconfigured KMS policies exist. Mitigation: enforcement behind opt-in flag, migration is non-destructive, automated checks added to installer, and rollout guided with manual checkpoints. Support runbook created (docs/security/kms-residency.md).
changelog_entry: Enforce KMS region residency checks via RBAC v2 policy flag and include structured KMS residency metadata in audit logs. See docs/security/kms-residency.md for migration and rollout.
notes: This change is targeted at compliance customers. Cloud deployments must ensure KMS keys are properly tagged with region metadata for residency verification. Contact SRE for migration windows.
